title: Pier Canvas default UI
description: Desktop-tool density and pier/canvas primitives only — calm, scannable overview chrome.
rules: Prefer Frame + Stack + Row + Text hierarchy
User manuals / multi-chapter docs: use DocsShell (sticky nav + main), not hand-rolled dual ScrollArea or dual-pane grids
Command inventories: ONE expandable Accordion list (name + description on trigger; details inside). Do not render a summary Table and a second Accordion of the same commands
Status badges: only mark unfinished/blocked (暂未实现 / CLI 默认不可用). Do not badge every shipped item as 已实现
Layout-critical geometry may use DocsShell or inline style; do not rely on canvas-only arbitrary Tailwind that may not be in the host CSS bundle
Single-line controls density aligns with host 28px
Use Badge for status, not decorative emoji
Tables for option/defaults inventories or compact matrices; prose for narrative only
One primary focus per view (squint test)
Mix open sections with cards; do not wrap every block in the same card
forbidden: rainbow status colors outside semantic Badge variants
Dual command inventory (Table + Accordion of the same set)
Badge spam on every shipped command
Dual ScrollArea + vh-height fake full-page shells inside Frame
agentPrompt: Apply Pier desktop-tool visual discipline. pier/canvas only. Docs → DocsShell. Command lists → single Accordion, badge only unfinished. No dual inventory, no dual ScrollArea shells. See references/authoring.md and sdk/core.d.ts DocsShell.
